title: Coastal fish curry from the morning catch 🐟🔥 #shorts
dish_fact: On India's coasts, fish curry changes village to village - Kerala leans on coconut and kokum, Goa on tangy tamarind and red chillies - but the morning catch simmered in a fiery coconut gravy is the coastal comfort food.

description:
South Indian coastal-style Fish Curry, from the morning catch to the plate 🐟🔥 — fresh fish simmered in a fiery coconut-and-tamarind gravy with mustard seeds and curry leaves, served over hot rice.

Coconut fish curry or spicy red fish curry — which side are you on? 👇 Comment!

🌿 Made with fresh fish, coconut, dried red chillies, turmeric, ginger, garlic, mustard seeds, curry leaves, tamarind and coconut milk.

Did you know? On India's coasts fish curry changes village to village — Kerala leans on coconut and kokum, Goa on tangy tamarind and red chillies — but the day's catch in a fiery coconut gravy is the ultimate coastal comfort food.
